THM은 1996년 독일 북부 슐레스비히홀슈타인의 작은 마을 알트 두벤슈: THM is a carbon component company founded in 1996 by Thomas Mertin and Petra Mertin in Alt Duvenstedt, a small village in Schleswig-Holstein, northern Germany. An aerospace engineer by profession, Thomas saw an opportunity in the fact that high-grade carbon technology from aviation was barely used in sport and leisure.
자전거 업계에 이름을 알린 것은 당시 세계에서 가장 가벼운 크랭크와 포크: The breakthrough in cycling came with what were then the world's lightest crankset and fork. Raced and proven by the Deutsche Telekom pro team, these parts were named THM-Carbones. To this day THM does everything itself, from design and tooling to testing and production, in its own factory in Alt Duvenstedt.

Lightest for real riders.<br/>실제로 타는 사람을:
Lightest for real riders.
The lightest parts, for people who actually ride.
THM의 경량은 무게를 깎아내는 데서 시작하지 않습니다. 힘이 지나가는: At THM, lightness does not start with cutting weight. We first analyse the path the load takes, then lay the fibres along it. Plenty where it is needed, nothing where it is not. That is why THM parts are so light, yet most are approved for a total weight of rider, bike and luggage of up to 110kg.
모든 제품은 THM이 직접 만든 시험 장비에서 적용 가능한 안전 규격을: Every product is tested on THM's own custom rigs to levels far beyond the applicable safety standards. Working closely with materials researchers in Germany and elsewhere, THM builds prototypes with production methods no one has tried yet and feeds the results straight back into its products.
형태보다 하중 경로가 먼저입니다. 정밀한 하중 분석 위에서 기하 구조와: Load path before form. Geometry and layup are defined on a precise load analysis, and the weight follows as a result.
수지 이송 성형(RTM)으로 공차와 일관성, 강도 대비 무게를 끌어올렸습: Resin transfer moulding (RTM) raises tolerancing, consistency and strength-to-weight. It also has less environmental impact than traditional carbon fabrication.
모든 제품은 알트 두벤슈테트 암 슈포르트플라츠의 공장에서 손으로 만듭니다: Every product is built by hand at the factory Am Sportplatz in Alt Duvenstedt. Almost every team member in Germany is directly involved in engineering and production.
쇄골(Clavicula), 종아리뼈(Fibula), 정강이뼈(Tibia): Collarbone (Clavicula), calf bone (Fibula), shinbone (Tibia), forearm bone (Ulna), jawbone (Mandibula). Every THM product is named after a bone in Latin.
“타협하지 않는 방식. 가장 가볍고 가장 강한 부품이 필요한 빌더들이 T: “A no-compromise approach. That is why builders who need the lightest and strongest components choose THM.”
항공우주 엔지니어 토마스 메르틴은 고급 카본 부품이 필요하지만 누구도 제: Aerospace engineer Thomas Mertin found, in cycling, a niche where high-grade carbon parts were needed but no one was making them properly. Founded together with Petra, THM began with cranks and forks and has grown to include brakes, stems, handlebars and seatposts.
THM의 포크 스카풀라(Scapula)는 스티어러부터 드롭아웃까지 끊기지: THM's Scapula fork was the first carbon fork built with continuous fibres running from the steerer all the way to the dropouts. Conceived with Formagic, a Cologne-based design studio, it went from CAD drawings to CNC-cut models, and every tool needed to make it was designed and built in-house by THM.
회사는 2016년 이탈리아의 3T와, 2020년부터는 같은 독일의 카본: The company joined Italy's 3T in 2016, and since 2020 has been part of Schmolke Carbon, a fellow German carbon component maker. Through these changes production, sales and customer support have remained independent, and every product is still made in Alt Duvenstedt.
From crankset to seatpost, nine parts built on the same principle.

Clavicula sine exceptione.<br/>예외 없는 규칙은:
Clavicula sine exceptione.
No rule without exception.
SE는 라틴어 sine exceptione, 예외 없이라는 뜻입니다. 클: SE stands for the Latin sine exceptione, without exception. The Clavicula SE is THM's top-line crank, its geometry and layup redefined on a precise analysis of load paths. Extraordinarily stiff in every plane, it transmits your power without loss, and weighs 293g with spider.
THM is particularly proud of the patented connection between the left crank and the axle. It is the first to successfully put a carbon-to-carbon interface into production at the heart of the drivetrain. Aligning the fibres of the external and internal splines reduces wear to almost nothing and eliminates noise.
30mm 카본 축이 크랭크와 한 몸으로 이어집니다. 금속 축을 쓰지 않아: The 30mm carbon axle runs as one piece with the cranks. With no metal axle, it sets a new mark for stiffness-to-weight.
특허받은 왼쪽 크랭크와 축의 결합부. 스플라인의 섬유 방향을 맞춰 마모와: The patented left crank to axle connection. Aligned spline fibres virtually eliminate wear and noise.
센시티부스 게이지(Sensitivus Gauge)와 함께 개발한 파워미터: A power meter developed with Sensitivus Gauge sits inside the axle. It adds under 27g, and you can keep riding your favourite lightweight pedals.
BSA와 ITA 나사식, BB30, BB30A, PF30, 시마노 프레스: Threaded BSA and ITA, BB30, BB30A, PF30, Shimano Pressfit, BB386 EVO and BBright. THM bottom brackets and bearings fit most frames.
THM의 기준이 되는 풀카본 로드 크랭크. 컴팩트(BCD 110)와 스탠: THM's reference full carbon road crank. Choose compact (BCD 110) or standard (BCD 130), gloss or matte, one of seven decal colours, with or without power meter.
8볼트 로드 다이렉트 마운트 인터페이스의 새 클라비큘라. 초슬림 암으로: The new Clavicula with an 8-bolt road direct mount interface. Ultra-slim arms cut frontal area, and the stiffness difference between drive and non-drive side is minimal.
인기 모델 클라비큘라 M³의 후속. 로드 버전처럼 카본 축이 두 크랭크를: Successor to the popular Clavicula M³. As on the road version, a carbon axle joins the cranks, and it is approved for categories X1 to X4.
스트레인 게이지와 작은 전자 모듈, 충전식 리튬이온 배터리를 모두 카본: Strain gauges, a small electronic module and a rechargeable lithium-ion battery all sit inside the carbon axle. The power meter adds under 27g, for a total of 320g compact and 329g standard.
왼쪽 다리를 기준으로 파워와 케이던스, 토크 효율, 페달링 부드러움을 측: Measuring from the left leg, it records power, cadence, torque effectiveness and pedal smoothness and transmits over ANT+ and Bluetooth. Accuracy is ±2%, a charge lasts around 150 hours, and it is IP67 waterproof. Power meter versions are made to order with long lead times, so please ask Rubi Workshop in advance.

피뷸라는 10년 넘게 대형 브랜드의 최상위 브레이크와 같은 성능을 절반의: For more than a decade, THM's Fibula rim brake has matched the performance of the top models from major brands at half their weight. Today's Fibula is redesigned for the era of wide rims, and gets its performance by fully exploiting the properties of carbon fibre.
새 피뷸라는 수지 이송 성형(RTM)으로 만들어 공차와 일관성, 강도 대: The new Fibula is made by resin transfer moulding (RTM) for better tolerancing, consistency and strength-to-weight, and even the return spring is composite. At 120g for the pair, it is still the lightest brakeset available.

THM의 콕핏은 스템 티비아와 핸들바 울나에서 출발합니다. 두 부품 모두: THM's cockpit starts with the Tibia stem and the Ulna handlebar. In both, fibres are chosen and laid to minimise stress differences, as nature does, making them extremely stiff yet smooth over road buzz.
프론탈레는 이 두 부품을 하나로 합친 일체형 콕핏이고, 프론탈레 에어로는: The Frontale merges the two into one integrated cockpit, and the Frontale Aero adds a slim NACA profile. All are ready for fully internal cable routing (ICR).
티타늄과 알루미늄 클램프 하드웨어로 볼트 나사 인서트를 없애, 카본 섬유: Titanium and aluminium clamping hardware removes threaded bolt inserts, so the carbon fibres run unbroken end to end. The faceplate is carbon too. The 80mm length is also approved for MTB.
THM modified its RTM process to create a structural rib through the drops. Invisible without an X-ray, this rib makes it the lightest bar for real riders, with a 110kg total weight limit.
가볍고 단단한 두 부품을 하나로 합쳐 깔끔한 콕핏을 만듭니다. 원하는 핸: Two very light, stiff parts merged for the cleanest cockpit. Choose your preferred bar angle at no extra cost.
상단부의 아주 얇은 NACA 단면이 좋은 항력 계수와 작은 전면 면적을: An extremely slim NACA profile on the top gives a good drag coefficient and a small frontal area, with no compromise in stiffness or weight.

섬유를 자르지 않는 스템: A stem that does not cut the fibres
Most carbon stems drill through the fibres and add threaded inserts for the bolts. Tibia solves this with new clamping hardware made of titanium and aluminium. With fibres running from end to end, it is the stiffest and strongest stem in the lightweight class.
자연의 형태에서 가져온 유선형 실루엣, 아주 작은 구조 요소까지 카본으로: A streamlined silhouette inspired by natural forms, and a faceplate made of carbon down to its smallest structural elements. Now ICR ready, please confirm D-shape steerer and headset specifications when ordering.
프론탈레 에어로는 우아한 에어로 디자인과 뛰어난 경량 구조를 하나로 묶었: The Frontale Aero combines elegant aero design with excellent lightweight construction. The NACA profile of the top is extremely slim, yet gives nothing away in stiffness or weight.
드롭 127mm, 리치 75mm, 플레어 7°와 스윕 3°. 폭은 38c: Drop 127mm, reach 75mm, 7° flare and 3° sweep. Widths from 38cm suit riders who want a narrow bar, and it comes in the same seven decal colours as the Clavicula. Computer mount sold separately.
목표는 단순했지만 이루기는 어려웠습니다. 2년의 개발 끝에 THM이 내놓: The goal was simple, achieving it was hard. After two years of development THM released the Mandibula. Comfort seatposts share one problem: the farther they stick out of the frame, the more they flex. Taller and heavier riders end up on a softer post.
만디불라는 포스트를 두 구역으로 나눕니다. 파워 존은 얼마나 노출되든 거: The Mandibula divides the post into two zones. The power zone is a stiff, light structure that hardly flexes however much is exposed, and the comfort zone gives exactly the right amount of comfort without becoming too much. Thanks to THM's layup, the saddle stays level through the flex.
카본 적층이 고케이던스 주행과 거친 노면, 코블에서 생기는 진동을 잡아: The carbon layup damps vibration from high-cadence riding, rough roads and cobbles, reducing fatigue. Suitable for road, gravel, cyclocross and cross-country MTB.
7mm 원형 또는 7 x 9mm 오벌 (두 규격 카본 하프셸 모두 포함): 7mm round or 7 x 9mm oval (carbon half-shells for both included)

From an aerospace engineer's workshop
to the benchmark for the lightest parts.
독일 북부의 한 엔지니어가 카본으로 크랭크와 포크를 만들기 시작한 199: From 1996, when an engineer in northern Germany began making cranks and forks from carbon, to today and the direct mount Clavicula. For 30 years THM has stayed true to a small team that designs and builds everything itself.
토마스와 페트라 메르틴이 알트 두벤슈테트에서 THM을 세웁니다. 항공우주: Thomas and Petra Mertin found THM in Alt Duvenstedt. The starting point was bringing aerospace carbon technology to sport and leisure.
당시 세계에서 가장 가벼운 크랭크와 포크를 만들고, 도이치 텔레콤 프로팀: THM builds what are then the world's lightest crank and fork, proven in racing by the Deutsche Telekom pro team. This is where the name THM-Carbones comes from.
회사가 꾸준히 성장하며 지금의 알트 두벤슈테트 암 슈포르트플라츠 공장으로: With steady growth, the company moves into its present factory Am Sportplatz in Alt Duvenstedt.
이탈리아 3T와 손잡습니다. 같은 해 유로바이크에서 RTM 공법의 새 피: THM joins forces with Italy's 3T. The same year at Eurobike it unveils the new RTM Fibula and a 78g Tibia stem at 100mm.
독일의 카본 부품 회사 쉬몰케 카본이 THM을 인수합니다. 두 회사는 생: Schmolke Carbon, a German carbon component maker, takes over THM. The two companies run production, sales and customer support independently.
8볼트 다이렉트 마운트 인터페이스의 클라비큘라 DM을 선보입니다. 260: THM introduces the Clavicula DM with an 8-bolt direct mount interface, continuing the Clavicula line at under 260g.
카본의 결과 마감은 직접 봐야 압니다. 루비워크샵에서 THM 부품을 직접: You have to see the weave and finish of the carbon in person. At Rubi Workshop you can see THM parts up close, and we will put together the right crank and cockpit for your frame and riding style. Custom build consultations are welcome too.
